f3_program: collection("water_case.bottles", "bottle", "water_case", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
observe(at("water_case.bottles.count", "current"), 24, "count", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
collection("camp.groups", "group", "camp", source("A children's camp comprising of 4 groups"))
observe(at("camp.groups.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("A children's camp comprising of 4 groups"))

sum_relation(at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.second.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.third.children.count", "current"), source("the number of the first three groups combined"))

fraction_of(at("camp.groups.fourth.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("the fourth group has half of the number of the first three groups combined"))
consume("daily_water_consumption_per_child", "each child", at("camp.water_bottles.count", "current"), 3, source("each child consumes 3 bottles a day"))
multiple(at("jenny.board_games.vs_jill.played.count", "current"), at("jenny.board_games.vs_mark.played.count", "current"), 2, source("she's played her twice as many times as she's played Mark"))
collection("jenny.board_game_wins.by_friend", "win_count", "jenny", source("Jenny won board games with her two friends"))
collection("water_tower.neighborhoods", "neighborhood", "water_tower", source("serves four neighborhoods around it"))
observe(at("water_tower.water_barrels.count", "initial"), 1200, "count", source("holds 1200 barrels of water and is filled to the top each week"))
consume("neighborhood_1_weekly_use", "first neighborhood", at("water_tower.water_barrels.count", "current"), 150, source("one neighborhood uses 150 barrels of water in a week"))

consume("neighborhood_2_weekly_use", "second neighborhood", at("water_tower.water_barrels.count", "current"), scale(event_field("neighborhood_1_weekly_use", "quantity"), 2), source("the second neighborhood uses twice as many barrels of water as the first neighborhood in a week"))

consume("neighborhood_3_weekly_use", "third neighborhood", at("water_tower.water_barrels.count", "current"), at("water_tower.neighborhoods.third.weekly_use.count", "week"), source("the third neighborhood uses one hundred more barrels of water than the second neighborhood in a week"))

offset(at("water_tower.neighborhoods.third.weekly_use.count", "week"), event_field("neighborhood_2_weekly_use", "quantity"), 100, "barrel", source("the third neighborhood uses one hundred more barrels of water than the second neighborhood in a week"))
percent_of(at("haleigh.old_candle.remaining_wax.weight", "current"), at("haleigh.old_candle.original_wax.weight", "initial"), 10, source("Each candle has 10% of it's original wax left"))
observe(at("company.money_market_funds.level_2_fair_value", "2019"), 2010, "thousand_currency", cell("Money market funds", "Significant Other Observable Inputs (Level 2)"))
